entities.name: KLF5
observations: In adult mouse intestinal epithelium, inducible deletion rapidly reduces crypt proliferation and increases apoptosis; proliferation can partially recover but remains impaired.
Klf5 loss in Lgr5-positive crypt-base-columnar cells reduces their proliferation and survival; later transit-amplifying-cell proliferation may re-emerge.

entities.name: Adult crypt proliferation
observations: Adult Villin-CreERT2;Klf5fl/fl mice showed reduced phospho-histone H3 and proliferative activity within 3 days, with increased crypt apoptosis; proliferation partially recovered but remained below wild type.

entities.name: Lgr5 stem-cell maintenance
observations: Adult Lgr5-lineage Klf5 deletion reduced crypt-base-columnar-cell proliferation and increased apoptosis; transit-amplifying proliferation later reappeared, while up to 90% of targeted Lgr5-positive cells were lost by day 112.
